submit_job: submit a job definition with task definitions to the Ray JobManager actor for execution
get_job_status: get the current status and progress details of a previously submitted job by job ID
get_job_results: get the results for all tasks within a completed or failed job by job ID
list_jobs: list all job IDs currently known by the JobManager actor
delete_job: delete a specific job by its job ID from the JobManager actor
